import pandas as pd
from datetime import date

AS_OF_DATE = date(2026,8,19)

# load orders
oh = pd.read_csv('don_hang.csv')
ct = pd.read_csv('chi_tiet_don.csv', dtype={'Ma don':'object'})

# parse dates
from datetime import datetime
def parse_date(s):
    s=str(s).strip()
    for fmt in ("%d/%m/%Y","%d %b %Y","%d %B %Y"):
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(s,fmt).date()
        except: pass
    return pd.to_datetime(s).date()

oh['d']=oh['NgayBan'].map(parse_date)
ct['d']=ct['Ma don'].map(lambda x: oh.loc[oh['Mã chứng từ']==x,'d'].iloc[0]) if False else None

# status mapping
status_map={'completed':'completed','cancelled':'cancelled','returned':'returned','shipping':'shipping'}
oh['status']=oh['Xử lý'].map(status_map)

# month 9/2025
mask=(oh['d']>=date(2025,9,1))&(oh['d']<=date(2025,9,30))
oh_m=oh[mask].copy()

# revenue orders: not cancelled, not returned -> completed or shipping
rev=oh_m[oh_m['status'].isin(['completed','shipping'])]
print("orders in sep2025 total:",len(oh_m))
print("status counts:",oh_m['status'].value_counts().to_dict())
print("revenue orders:",len(rev))

# sum T.Tiền from chi_tiet_don
ct['Ma don']=ct['Ma don'].astype(str)
rev_codes=rev['Mã chứng từ'].astype(str).tolist()
ct_rev=ct[ct['Ma don'].isin(rev_codes)]
total_rev=ct_rev['T.Tiền'].sum()
print("total revenue:",total_rev)
print("avg:",total_rev/len(rev))
